content.answer_markdown:
The controls that keep the LLM from inventing figures include:

1. The deterministic engine owns every number and every compliance outcome; the LLM only explains and proposes (ADR-0001).
2. Every claim made by the LLM needs a citation; Report quotes must appear on the cited page and numbers must match cited engine figures.
3. Research Tilts are clipped by the engine to the configured bound; only approved Insights can influence them.
4. Ungrounded claims are flagged, kept out of memos, and remain visible to the Advisor.
5. A human accepts, modifies, or rejects every Recommendation; nothing is executed automatically.

These controls ensure that the LLM does not invent figures but relies strictly on engine-owned data and approved sources.
